Author: Ajimsan2096
Name: LinguaBridge
Description:
Translates chat between two languages in both directions (English <-> French by default) with DeepL (best quality, free API key) or Google (no key), with automatic fallback.

- Incoming messages get a translated line in the same chat tab.
- /tr translates and sends your messages: /tr /p Hello everyone!
- History window with one-click translated replies and a preview with back-translation.
- Item links, auto-translate phrases and names are never translated.
- Party Finder: right-click > Translate description.
- Setup wizard, server-bar on/off switch.
Punchline: Real-time chat translation between two languages (EN <-> FR by default).
